race.comment: Nathan Doyle holds the key to the race with three leading chances. BETTER LATE (11) bounced off his unlucky first-up second, with a commanding on-pace win from the wide gate over 1200m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Maps well and can progress quickly this prep. HEROIC DEED (4) is building a tidy win record with three victories from four starts. Rounded up a decent field last start to salute as fav over 1200m at Warwick Farm in this class. Hard to stop in this vein of form and Morgan sticks. FORMAL (7) comes here deep into the prep with the key jockey change. Yet to win past 1100m but gets his chance with the fast early tempo. VETWELVE (8) can pull out a big run fresh after the two sound trials.
